race.comment: ADMIRE ASTRA (1) placed in the Listed Natasha Stakes and the G3 WA Oaks at this track before spelling, showing she was above average in the process. She has had two trials since and the 3kg claim helps as she resumes at a mile. Maps for a lovely run and she can resume on a winning note. PRINCE EPAULETTE (2) resumed with a close BM58+ second at Geraldton after beginning slowly and racing wide, and his record around this distance gives him genuine winning claims if he gets some luck from the draw. ACTA NON VERBA (4) has put together two thirds in CL3 company and returns to a distance that has brought one win and three placings from six tries. PLAYING SOLO (14) can improve on a disappointing performance last time out as he steps out in trip from a better barrier.
